title: Brighten Infinigen kitchen ceiling lights and recook
objective: Update the existing /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen Unreal map with bright overhead ceiling lights that can be reduced/disabled by existing runtime scene-light controls, then recook/package/verify the active Linux paks.
instructions: Create a new run directory under .control-tower/runs and run all Unreal editor/cook work through a named tmux session/window. Return attach command, exact commands, log paths, validation outputs, and dry-run commands.

Use an editor Python script stored only in the run directory. Load map /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen, destroy prior actors whose labels start with InfinigenKitchen_, then create bright warm-white overhead RectLight fixtures with labels like InfinigenKitchen_BrightCeiling_RectLight_*. Use movable RectLight actors, multiple ceiling panels distributed across the map bounds, commercial kitchen style color temperature around 3800-4200K, and base intensities high enough to be visibly bright at --scene-light-intensity-scale 1.0. Keep Setup_DirectionalLight and Setup_SkyLight low/non-dominant so the ceiling lights are the controllable scene illumination.

Recommended starting fixture plan: 8-10 rectangular ceiling panels at z around 300-330, width about 130-180, height 18-30, attenuation radius around 550-750, intensity around 900-1800 per fixture. Use judgement from existing map bounds; record actual values in validation_report.json. Include a small optional counter/pass accent only if it will not dominate.

Validate and save a JSON report with map_exists, mesh asset/static mesh actor counts, light actor/component counts, all generated light labels, locations, intensities, attenuation, mobility, temperature/use_temperature, source width/height where available, and bounds. The report should explicitly state that runtime scaling uses examples/flashlight/run.py --scene-light-intensity-scale to multiply scene light component intensity and --disable-scene-lights to hide light components.

Recook/package active Linux build including every non-null docs/environment_ledger.json unreal_map_path, then verify both archive and staged paks contain every ledger map and specifically infinigen_indoors_kitchen .umap and .uexp. Use tools/run_uat.py with --clean-archive-dir --skip-cook-default-maps --cook-maps ... -clean -cook -stage -package -archive -pak -skipbuild. Tee logs.

Run dry-run commands and capture output: tools/spear-run live infinigen_indoors_kitchen --setting realistic-2x --dry-run, plus exact direct commands for bright ceiling lights at scale 1.0, dim/reduced lights at scale 0.1 or 0.02, and scene-off at scale 0.0 or --disable-scene-lights.
constraints: Do not edit tracked product source or docs. Do not commit or push.
expected_outputs: Map lighting updated, validation report written, Linux package recooked and pak-verified, dry-run commands captured.
definition_of_done: Both active paks contain infinigen_indoors_kitchen .umap/.uexp after lighting changes; validation report lists bright ceiling light actors/intensities; user-facing commands are included.
